SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'BNKM' AND TABLE_NAME ='CustomerAccountPeriodBalance';

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [BNKM].[CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_WITH_DUP_20230523]
( 
	[RN] [int]  NOT NULL,
	[CustomerAccountId] [varchar](50)  NOT NULL,
	[PeriodBalanceTypeId] [varchar](50)  NOT NULL,
	[PeriodStartDate] [datetime]  NOT NULL,
	[PeriodEndDate] [datetime]  NULL,
	[BillingCycleId] [int]  NULL,
	[BalanceAmount] [numeric](18,5)  NULL,
	[IsoCurrencyCode] [char](3)  NULL,
	[FinancialInstitutionId] [nvarchar](32)  NOT NULL,
	[PeriodMonthYear] [varchar](10)  NULL,
	[PeriodQuarterYear] [varchar](6)  NULL,
	[SourceSystemCode] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	[TaskRunId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[WorkFlowId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[InsertDttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
GO





--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT  CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE ORDER BY PeriodEndDate DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
*  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance;


--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_WITH_DUP_20230523
29563632
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
29563632


--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[CustomerAccountId]
,[PeriodBalanceTypeId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[BillingCycleId]
,[BalanceAmount]
,[IsoCurrencyCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[PeriodMonthYear]
,[PeriodQuarterYear]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_WITH_DUP_20230523 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;

--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT  CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1


SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
